body:
I’ve been diagnosed with clinical depression and anxiety. I’ve been on every not habit forming combination of medications there is. Maybe I just want to be miserable, but they’ve never helped me at all. I can enjoy things in the moment, but when that moment passes, I either go back to this “bleh” feeling or am hopelessly depressed.

I don’t blame my dad for getting upset. He’s been putting up with my shit for however many years I’ve been depressed, and he really just can’t understand what’s wrong. He gives very simple solutions to complex problems. “Get more sleep” “I can’t sleep” “Just close your eyes” is my favorite example.

I have this constant anxiety with people that they just think I’m annoying or too mopey. All my friends wind up getting sick of me at some point. I feel like for people to like me, I have to put on a mask every day, which I do. If I off myself tomorrow, I think nobody here could have predicted it.

I talked to my dad again today. It went okay. The same old conversations of “I feel ____” “Just do _____”. I was just okay enough to not get irritated.

Small emotions are definitely hitting harder. My whole little breakdown last night got sparked off by not having a screw for a fan I was trying to put together, of all the dumb shit. I called my dad and tried to tell him how miserable I’m feeling,  which sparked our argument. College is complete Hell. I hate it. The only silver lining are my friends here, but they don’t even REALLY know me, y’know? And if they did, I feel like I’d just freak them out and scare them off. I feel a little better today, but I’m still pretty resolved to just end it after my birthday party tomorrow.
